tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon observations directly show the predicted endogenous sign reversal. Fit the archived four-parameter dual-horizon law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight observations spanning short and long horizons already identify the four-parameter dual-exponential candidate.
All observed sink gradients are zero, so its sink parameter is unidentifiable; the simpler archived reversal mechanism matches the observed signature.
A positive short-horizon response followed by negative long-horizon response requires a reversal absent from the basic single-timescale model.
